note: Task DEFINITIONS only. This register holds metadata describing public BEIR benchmark tasks so retrieval changes can later be tested on unseen task types; the datasets themselves are not in this tree, and fetching one is a separate act under its own terms (see each task's homepage and licence_note). The golden set (evaluation/golden-questions.jsonl) is not part of this register and is never touched by the BEIR harness.
